title: 1992 AHSME Problem 13
statement: How many pairs of positive integers \((a,b)\) with \(a+b\le100\) satisfy the equation \[ \frac{a+b^{-1}}{a^{-1}+b}=13? \]

solutions.text:
Multiplying the numerator and denominator by \(ab\) gives \[ \frac{a^2b+a}{b+ab^2} =\frac{a(ab+1)}{b(ab+1)} =\frac ab. \] Thus \(a=13b.\) The condition \(a+b\le100\) becomes \(14b\le100,\) so \(b\) may be any integer from \(1\) through \(7.\) There are \(7\) pairs.

Thus the correct answer is C.
